reviews.body: Thanks for addressing this. Please remove the regression spec though, it feels like an overkill to cover this specific case with a dedicated scenario. We could consider adding an e2e smoke test scenario later on to cover reloading/eager/lazy loading that would ensure our patches work as expected.

comments.body:
Removed the isolated boot regression spec and its fixture as requested. The existing Solid Queue and recurring job specs passed with 90 examples on Rails 8.1.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
